name: cache
description: Configures caching services by installing and configuring Memcached and Redis, creating a Redis log directory, applying a custom config cleanup, and enabling the Redis service.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application, handling package installation, repository cloning, virtual environment setup, dependency installation, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment file creation, systemd service configuration, and service startup.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Sets up a multi‑site Nginx reverse‑proxy with SSL, configuring core and per‑site settings, creating document roots, installing Fail2Ban and UFW firewall, hardening SSH, generating self‑signed certificates, and applying sysctl security tweaks.
